types.summary: Represents a CAD drawing document, providing access to all collections, tables, and configuration objects within the drawing. Supports management of entities, layers, styles, dictionaries, and other core CAD structures.
types.remarks: The CadDocument class serves as the root container for all objects and settings in a CAD drawing. It provides methods to retrieve, configure, and manage drawing content, including entities, tables, and dictionaries. Many collections are initialized automatically, but some may be null if the corresponding dictionary entry does not exist in the root dictionary.

members.summary: Sets the value of a specified property on a CAD object, converting the value as needed based on the property's type.
members.remarks: This method supports setting values for various property types, including vectors (CSMath.XY and CSMath.XYZ), colors (ACadSharp.Color), margins (ACadSharp.Objects.PaperMargin), transparency (ACadSharp.Transparency), and other primitive or enum types. The behavior of the method depends on the property's type and the provided code.

parameters.code: A code that determines how the value should be interpreted or applied. The interpretation of this code depends on the property's type.

Supported types include string, numeric types, boolean, byte arrays, and custom handled objects, depending on the group code. types.summary: Defines the contract for a CAD entity, providing common properties and methods for graphical objects within a CAD document.
types.remarks: The ACadSharp.Entities.IEntity interface exposes standard attributes such as color, layer, linetype, line weight, material, and transparency, as well as methods to resolve effective property values and to match properties with another entity. Implementations are expected to represent geometric or drawable objects in a CAD environment. This interface extends IHandledCadObject and IGeometricEntity, ensuring that all entities have unique handles and geometric characteristics. Thread safety and mutability depend on the specific implementation.

This property overrides the value from ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderStyle when the F:ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeaderPropertyOverrideFlags.TextAttachmentDirection flag is set in the ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeader.PropertyOverrideFlags property.
members.remarks: This property defines whether the leaders attach to the left/right of the content block/text, or attach to the top/bottom.The value for all leader lines can be overridden for each individual leader line by the ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.LeaderRoot.TextAttachmentDirection property when the F:ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeaderPropertyOverrideFlags.TextAttachmentDirection flag is set in the ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.LeaderLine.OverrideFlags property.
members.value: A ACadSharp.TextAttachmentDirectionType.

members.name: TextAttachmentPoint
members.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating the text attachment point.
members.remarks: The Open Design Specification for DWG files documents this property as Justification, the DXF reference as Text Attachments point.This property is also exposed by the ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeader class (ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeader.TextAttachmentPoint). The ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.TextAttachmentPoint property always has the same value and seems to have the respective value as ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.TextAlignment. The ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.TextAttachmentPoint property is to be used.

members.name: TextBottomAttachment
members.summary: Gets or sets the text bottom attachment type (see ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderStyle.TextBottomAttachment). This property override the value from ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderStyle when the F:ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeaderPropertyOverrideFlags.TextBottomAttachment flag is set (see ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeader.PropertyOverrideFlags property).
members.remarks: This property is also exposed by the ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData class. Values should be equal, the value ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.TextBottomAttachment is assumed to be used.
members.value: A ACadSharp.TextAttachmentType having the values 9 = Center, 10 = Underline and Center can be used ("vertical" attachment types).

members.name: TextColor
members.summary: Gets or sets the color for the display of the text label. This property overrides the value from ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderStyle when the F:ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeaderPropertyOverrideFlags.TextColor flag is set (see ACadSharp.Entities.MultiLeader.PropertyOverrideFlags property).
members.remarks: This property is also exposed by the ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData class. Values should be equal, the value ACadSharp.Objects.MultiLeaderObjectContextData.TextColor is assumed to be used.

members.name: PointOnSpline
members.summary: Calculates the point on the spline at the specified parametric position.
members.returns: The point on the spline at the specified parametric position, represented as an CSMath.XYZ object.

parameters.t: The parametric position along the spline, where 0 represents the start of the spline and 1 represents the end. Must be a value between 0 and 1.

exceptions.description: Thrown if t is less than 0 or greater than 1.

members.name: PolygonalVertexes
members.summary: Generates a list of vertex points representing a polygonal approximation of the curve.
members.remarks: The method calculates the vertex points by dividing the curve into segments based on the specified precision. If the curve is not closed or periodic, the last control point is explicitly added to the result.
members.returns: A list of CSMath.XYZ objects representing the vertex points of the polygonal approximation.

parameters.precision: The number of segments used to approximate the curve. Must be equal to or greater than 2.

exceptions.description: Thrown if precision is less than 2.

members.name: TryPointOnSpline
members.signature: System.Boolean TryPointOnSpline(System.Double t, out CSMath.XYZ point)
members.summary: Attempts to calculate a point on the spline at the specified parameter value.
members.remarks: This method catches any exceptions that occur during the calculation and returns false in such cases. Ensure that the parameter t is within the valid range for the spline to avoid errors.
members.returns: true if the point was successfully calculated; otherwise, false.

parameters.t: The parameter value along the spline, typically in the range [0, 1].
parameters.point: When this method returns, contains the calculated point on the spline if the operation succeeds; otherwise, F:CSMath.XYZ.NaN. This parameter is passed uninitialized.

members.name: TryPolygonalVertexes
members.summary: Attempts to calculate the polygonal vertexes of the current object with the specified precision.
members.remarks: This method catches and suppresses any exceptions that occur during the calculation, returning false in such cases. The points parameter will always be initialized, even if the operation fails.
members.returns: true if the polygonal vertexes were successfully calculated; otherwise, false.

parameters.precision: The level of precision to use when calculating the polygonal vertexes. Must be a positive integer.
parameters.points: When this method returns, contains a list of CSMath.XYZ objects representing the calculated polygonal vertexes, if the operation succeeds; otherwise, contains an empty list.

members.name: UpdateFromFitPoints
members.summary: Updates the spline's control points, knots, and weights based on the current fit points and tangents.
members.remarks: This method performs the following operations: Validates the spline's degree, fit points, and knot parametrization. Generates knots and control points based on the fit points and tangents. Refines the tangents iteratively if necessary, up to the specified iteration limit. Assigns uniform weights to the control points. The method returns false if the spline's degree is not 3, if there are fewer than two fit points, if the knot parametrization is set to F:ACadSharp.Entities.KnotParametrization.Custom, or if tangent refinement fails.
members.returns: true if the spline was successfully updated; otherwise, false.

parameters.iterationLimit: The maximum number of iterations allowed for refining the tangents. Defaults to F:System.Byte.MaxValue.

parameters.polyline: The polyline from which to retrieve the points. Cannot be null.

members.name: GetPoints
members.signature: static System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable[T] GetPoints[T](ACadSharp.Entities.IPolyline polyline, System.Int32 precision)
members.summary: Generates a collection of points representing the vertices of the specified polyline, including interpolated points for arcs based on the given precision.
members.remarks: This method processes the vertices of the polyline and generates a sequence of points. For straight segments, the start and end points are included. For arc segments, additional points are interpolated based on the specified precision. If the polyline is closed, the method ensures continuity by connecting the last vertex to the first.
members.returns: An System.Collections.Generic.IEnumerable`1 containing the points of the polyline, including interpolated points for arcs.

parameters.polyline: The polyline from which to extract points. The polyline may contain straight segments and arcs.
parameters.precision: The number of points to generate for each arc segment. Must be equal to or greater than 2.

exceptions.description: Thrown if precision is less than 2.

types.summary: Provides factory methods for creating CAD file readers based on file format.
types.remarks: Use this class to obtain an appropriate ICadReader instance for supported CAD file types such as DWG and DXF. The factory selects the correct reader implementation based on the file extension. This class does not validate file existence or content; it only inspects the file extension.

members.name: CreateReader
members.signature: static ACadSharp.IO.ICadReader CreateReader(System.String filename, ACadSharp.IO.NotificationEventHandler notification = null)
members.summary: Creates an ACadSharp.IO.ICadReader instance for the specified CAD file format.
members.remarks: Supported file formats include DWG and DXF. The method selects the appropriate reader based on the file extension.
members.returns: An ACadSharp.IO.ICadReader instance capable of reading the specified CAD file.

parameters.filename: The path to the CAD file to read. The file extension determines the reader type. Must not be null or empty.
parameters.notification: An optional event handler for receiving notifications during the reading process. Can be null if no notifications are needed.

exceptions.description: Thrown if the file extension is not supported.

members.name: GetFileFormat
members.summary: Determines the CAD file format based on the file extension of the specified filename.
members.remarks: The method does not validate whether the file exists or whether the file content matches the extension. Only the file extension is considered when determining the format.
members.returns: A value of the CadFileFormat enumeration that corresponds to the file's extension. Returns F:ACadSharp.IO.CadFileFormat.DWG for ".dwg" files, F:ACadSharp.IO.CadFileFormat.DXF for ".dxf" files, or F:ACadSharp.IO.CadFileFormat.Unknown if the extension is not recognized.

parameters.filename: The path or name of the file whose format is to be identified. The file extension is used to determine the format.

members.name: StyleOverrideEntryName
members.summary: Represents the entry name used for style override data in the underlying storage format.
members.remarks: This constant can be used when reading from or writing to data sources that require a specific entry name for style overrides. The value is case-sensitive.

members.summary: Apply the rounding of the style to the value.

parameters.value: value to apply the style rounding.
parameters.isAlternate: flag to indicate to use the alternate rounding.

members.name: GetAlternateUnitStyleFormat
members.summary: Get the alternate unit style format for this dimension style.

members.name: GetUnitStyleFormat
members.summary: Get the unit style format for this dimension style.

members.name: AlternateDimensioningSuffix
members.summary: Specifies a text prefix or suffix (or both) to the alternate dimension measurement for all types of dimensions except angular (see DIMAPOST System Variable).
members.remarks: For instance, if the current units are Architectural, ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.AlternateUnitDimensioning is on (true), ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.AlternateUnitScaleFactor is 25.4 (the number of millimeters per inch), ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.AlternateUnitDecimalPlaces is 2, and AlternateDimensioningSuffix is set to "mm", a distance of 10 units would be displayed as 10"[254.00mm].To turn off an established prefix or suffix (or both), set it to a single period (.).

members.name: AlternateUnitDecimalPlaces
members.summary: Controls the number of decimal places in alternate units (see DIMALTD System Variable).
members.remarks: If ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.AlternateUnitDimensioning is turned on (true), AlternateUnitDecimalPlaces specifies the number of digits displayed to the right of the decimal point in the alternate measurement.

members.name: AlternateUnitDimensioning
members.summary: Controls the display of alternate units in dimensions (see DIMALT System Variable).
members.value: true enables alternate units; false disables alternate units.

members.name: AlternateUnitFormat
members.summary: Gets or sets the units format for alternate units of all dimension sub-styles except Angular (see DIMALTU System Variable).

members.name: AlternateUnitRounding
members.summary: Rounds off the alternate dimension units (see DIMALTRND System Variable).

members.name: AlternateUnitScaleFactor
members.summary: Controls the multiplier for alternate units (see DIMALTF System Variable).
members.remarks: If ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.AlternateUnitDimensioning is turned on (true), the value of this property (AlternateUnitScaleFactor) multiplies linear dimensions by a factor to produce a value in an alternate system of measurement. The initial value represents the number of millimeters in an inch.

members.name: AlternateUnitToleranceDecimalPlaces
members.summary: Gets or sets the number of decimal places for the tolerance values in the alternate units of a dimension (see DIMALTTD System Variable).

members.name: AlternateUnitToleranceZeroHandling
members.summary: Controls suppression of zeros in tolerance values (see DIMALTTZ System Variable).

members.name: AlternateUnitZeroHandling
members.summary: Controls the suppression of zeros for alternate unit dimension values (see DIMALTZ System Variable).

members.name: AngularDecimalPlaces
members.summary: Controls the number of precision places displayed in angular dimensions (see DIMADEC System Variable).
members.value: -1: Angular dimensions display the number of decimal places specified by the ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.DecimalPlaces property0-8: Specifies the number of decimal places displayed in angular dimensions (independent of the value of the ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.DecimalPlaces property).

members.name: AngularUnit
members.summary: Gets or sets the units format for angular dimensions (see DIMAUNIT System Variable).

members.name: AngularZeroHandling
members.summary: Suppresses zeros for angular dimensions (see DIMAZIN System Variable).

members.name: ArcLengthSymbolPosition
members.summary: Controls display of the arc symbol in an arc length dimension (see DIMARCSYM System Variable).

members.name: ArrowBlock
members.summary: Gets or sets the arrowhead block displayed at the ends of dimension lines (see DIMBLK System Variable).
members.remarks: Note: Annotative blocks cannot be used as custom arrowheads for dimensions or leaders.
members.value: A ACadSharp.Tables.BlockRecord that makes up an arrowhead or null if the default, closed-filled arrowhead is to be displayed.

members.name: ArrowSize
members.summary: Controls the size of dimension line and leader line arrowheads. Also controls the size of hook lines (see DIMASZ System Variable).

members.name: CenterMarkSize
members.summary: Controls drawing of circle or arc center marks and centerlines by the DIMCENTER, DIMDIAMETER, and DIMRADIUS commands (see DIMCEN System Variable).
members.remarks: For DIMDIAMETER and DIMRADIUS, the center mark is drawn only if you place the dimension line outside the circle or arc.
members.value: 0No center marks or lines are drawn<0Centerlines are drawn>0Center marks are drawn

members.name: CursorUpdate
members.summary: Controls options for user-positioned text (see DIMUPT System Variable).
members.value: false: Cursor controls only the dimension line location.true: Cursor controls both the text position and the dimension line location,

members.name: DecimalPlaces
members.summary: Gets or sets the number of decimal places displayed for the primary units of a dimension (see DIMDEC System Variable).

members.name: DecimalSeparator
members.summary: Specifies a single-character decimal separator to use when creating dimensions whose unit format is decimal (see DIMDSEP System Variable).
members.remarks: When prompted, enter a single character at the Command prompt. If dimension units is set to Decimal, the DecimalSeparator character is used instead of the default decimal point. If DecimalSeparator is set to NULL (default value), the decimal point is used as the dimension separator.

members.name: Default
members.summary: Gets the default dimension style instance with standard settings.
members.remarks: Use this property to obtain a baseline dimension style for creating or resetting dimension-related objects. The returned instance uses the default configuration defined by the system.

members.name: DimArrow1
members.summary: Gets or sets the arrowhead for the first end of the dimension line when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.SeparateArrowBlocks is on (true) (see DIMBLK1 System Variable).
members.remarks: Note: Annotative blocks cannot be used as custom arrowheads for dimensions or leaders.
members.value: A ACadSharp.Tables.BlockRecord that makes up an arrowhead or null if the default, closed-filled arrowhead is to be displayed.

members.name: DimArrow2
members.summary: Gets or sets the arrowhead for the first end of the dimension line when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.SeparateArrowBlocks is on (true) (see DIMBLK2 System Variable).
members.remarks: Note: Annotative blocks cannot be used as custom arrowheads for dimensions or leaders.
members.value: A ACadSharp.Tables.BlockRecord that makes up an arrowhead or null if the default, closed-filled arrowhead is to be displayed.

members.name: DimensionFit
members.summary: Determines how dimension text and arrows are arranged when space is not sufficient to place both within the extension lines. (see DIMFIT System Variable).

members.name: DimensionLineColor
members.summary: Gets or sets colors to dimension lines, arrowheads, and dimension leader lines (see DIMCLRD System Variable).
members.remarks: Also controls the color of leader lines created with the LEADER command.

members.name: DimensionLineExtension
members.summary: Sets the distance the dimension line extends beyond the extension line when oblique strokes are drawn instead of arrowheads. (see DIMDLE System Variable).

members.name: DimensionLineGap
members.summary: Gets or sets the distance around the dimension text when the dimension line breaks to accommodate dimension text (see DIMGAP System Variable).
members.remarks: Also sets the gap between annotation and a hook line created with the LEADER command. If you enter a negative value, DimensionLineGap places a box around the dimension text.The value of DimensionLineGap is also used as the minimum length of each segment of the dimension line. To locate the components of a linear dimension within the extension lines, enough space must be available for both arrowheads (2 x ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.ArrowSize), both dimension line segments (2 x DimensionLineGap), a gap on either side of the dimension text (another 2 x DimensionLineGap), and the length of the dimension text, which depends on its size and number of decimal places displayed.

members.name: DimensionLineIncrement
members.summary: Controls the spacing of the dimension lines in baseline dimensions (see DIMDLI System Variable).
members.remarks: Each dimension line is offset from the previous one by this amount, if necessary, to avoid drawing over it. Changes made with DimensionLineIncrement are not applied to existing dimensions.

members.name: DimensionLineWeight
members.summary: Assigns line weight to dimension lines (see DIMLWD System Variable).
members.value: Positive values represent line weight in hundredths of millimeters. (Multiply a value by 2540 to convert values from inches to hundredths of millimeters.)

members.name: DimensionTextArrowFit
members.summary: Determines how dimension text and arrows are arranged when space is not sufficient to place both within the extension lines. (see DIMATFIT System Variable).
members.remarks: A leader is added to moved dimension text when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.TextMovement is set to F:ACadSharp.Tables.TextMovement.AddLeaderWhenTextMoved.

members.name: DimensionUnit
members.summary: DIMUNIT (obsolete, now use DIMLUNIT AND DIMFRAC)

members.name: ExtensionLineColor
members.summary: Gets or sets colors to extension lines, center marks, and centerlines (see DIMCLRE System Variable).

members.name: ExtensionLineExtension
members.summary: Specifies how far to extend the extension line beyond the dimension line (see DIMEXE System Variable).

members.name: ExtensionLineOffset
members.summary: Specifies how far extension lines are offset from origin points (see DIMEXO System Variable).
members.remarks: With fixed-length extension lines, this value determines the minimum offset.

members.name: ExtensionLineWeight
members.summary: Assigns line weight to extension lines (see DIMLWE System Variable).
members.value: Positive values represent line weight in hundredths of millimeters. (Multiply a value by 2540 to convert values from inches to hundredths of millimeters.)

members.name: FixedExtensionLineLength
members.summary: Sets the total length of the extension lines starting from the dimension line toward the dimension origin (see DIMFXL System Variable).

members.name: FractionFormat
members.summary: Gets or sets the fraction format when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.LinearUnitFormat is set to 4 (Architectural) or 5 (Fractional). (see DIMFRAC System Variable).

members.name: GenerateTolerances
members.summary: Appends tolerances to dimension text (see DIMTOL System Variable).
members.remarks: Setting GenerateTolerances to on (true) turns ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.LimitsGeneration off (false).

members.name: IsExtensionLineLengthFixed
members.summary: Controls whether extension lines are set to a fixed length (see DIMFXLON System Variable).
members.value: true when extension lines are set to the length specified by ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.FixedExtensionLineLength; otherwise, false.

members.name: JoggedRadiusDimensionTransverseSegmentAngle
members.summary: Determines the angle of the transverse segment of the dimension line in a jogged radius dimension in radians. (see DIMJOGANG System Variable).
members.value: Jogged radius dimensions are often created when the center point is located off the page. Valid settings range is 5 to 90 degrees.

members.name: LeaderArrow
members.summary: Specifies the arrow type for leaders (see DIMLDRBLK System Variable).
members.remarks: Note: Annotative blocks cannot be used as custom arrowheads for dimensions or leaders.
members.value: A ACadSharp.Tables.BlockRecord that makes up an arrowhead or null if the default, closed-filled arrowhead is to be displayed.

members.name: LimitsGeneration
members.summary: Generates dimension limits as the default text (see DIMLIM System Variable).
members.remarks: Setting LimitsGeneration to on (true) turns ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.GenerateTolerances off (false).

members.name: LineType
members.summary: Line type for the main line of the dimension.

members.name: LineTypeExt1
members.summary: Line type for the extension line 1.

members.name: LineTypeExt2
members.summary: Line type for the extension line 2.

members.name: LinearScaleFactor
members.summary: Sets a scale factor for linear dimension measurements (see DIMLFAC System Variable).
members.remarks: All linear dimension distances, including radii, diameters, and coordinates, are multiplied by this LinearScaleFactor before being converted to dimension text. Positive values of LinearScaleFactor are applied to dimensions in both model space and paper space; negative values are applied to paper space only.LinearScaleFactor applies primarily to non-associative dimensions (DIMASSOC set 0 or 1). For non-associative dimensions in paper space, LinearScaleFactor must be set individually for each layout viewport to accommodate viewport scaling.LinearScaleFactor has no effect on angular dimensions, and is not applied to the values held in ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.Rounding, ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.MinusTolerance, or ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.PlusTolerance.

members.name: LinearUnitFormat
members.summary: Gets or sets units for all dimension types except Angular (see DIMLUNIT System Variable).

members.name: MinusTolerance
members.summary: Gets or sets the minimum (or lower) tolerance limit for dimension text when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.GenerateTolerances or ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.LimitsGeneration is on (true). (see DIMTM System Variable).
members.remarks: MinusTolerance accepts signed values. If ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.GenerateTolerances is on and ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.PlusTolerance and MinusTolerance are set to the same value, a tolerance value is drawn.If MinusTolerance and ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.PlusTolerance values differ, the upper tolerance is drawn above the lower, and a plus sign is added to the ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.PlusTolerance value if it is positive.For MinusTolerance, the program uses the negative of the value you enter (adding a minus sign if you specify a positive number and a plus sign if you specify a negative number).

members.name: PlusTolerance
members.summary: Gets or sets the maximum (or upper) tolerance limit for dimension text when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.GenerateTolerances or ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.LimitsGeneration is on (true) (see DIMTP System Variable).

members.name: PostFix
members.summary: Specifies a text prefix or suffix (or both) to the dimension measurement (see DIMPOST System Variable).
members.remarks: For example, to establish a suffix for millimeters, set PostFix to mm; a distance of 19.2 units would be displayed as 19.2 mm.If tolerances are turned on, the suffix is applied to the tolerances as well as to the main dimension.Use <> to indicate placement of the text in relation to the dimension value. For example, enter <> mm to display a 5.0 millimeter radial dimension as "5.0mm". If you entered mm <>, the dimension would be displayed as "mm 5.0". Use the <> mechanism for angular dimensions.

members.name: Prefix
members.summary: Gets or sets the prefix based on the ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.PostFix value.

members.name: Rounding
members.summary: Rounds all dimensioning distances to the specified value (see DIMRND System Variable).
members.remarks: For instance, if Rounding is set to 0.25, all distances round to the nearest 0.25 unit. If you set the value to 1.0, all distances round to the nearest integer.Note that the number of digits edited after the decimal point depends on the precision set by ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.DecimalPlaces.This does not apply to angular dimensions.

members.name: ScaleFactor
members.summary: Gets or sets the overall scale factor applied to dimensioning variables that specify sizes, distances, or offsets (see DIMSCALE System Variable).
members.remarks: This ScaleFactor does not affect measured lengths, coordinates, or angles.Use ScaleFactor to control the overall scale of dimensions. However, if the current dimension style is annotative, ScaleFactor is automatically set to zero and the dimension scale is controlled by the CANNOSCALE system variable. ScaleFactor cannot be set to a non-zero value when using annotative dimensions.Also affects the leader objects with the LEADER command.Use MLEADERSCALE to scale multileader objects created with the MLEADER command.
members.value: 1.0A reasonable default value is computed based on the scaling between the current model space viewport and paper space. If you are in paper space or model space and not using the paper space feature, the scale factor is 1.0.>0A scale factor is computed that leads text sizes, arrowhead sizes, and other scaled distances to plot at their face values.

members.name: SeparateArrowBlocks
members.summary: Controls the display of dimension line arrowhead blocks (see DIMSAH System Variable).
members.value: true if arrowhead blocks set by ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.DimArrow1 and ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.DimArrow2 shall be used; false if arrowhead block set by ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.ArrowBlock shall be used.

members.name: SuppressFirstExtensionLine
members.summary: Suppresses display of the first extension line (see DIMSE1 System Variable).
members.value: true if the first extension line is to be suppressed; otherwise false.

members.name: SuppressOutsideExtensions

members.value: true if arrowheads are to be suppressed; otherwise, false.

members.name: SuppressSecondDimensionLine
members.summary: Controls suppression of the second dimension line and arrowhead (see DIMSD2 System Variable).
members.value: true if the second dimension line is to be suppressed; otherwise, false.

members.name: SuppressSecondExtensionLine
members.summary: Suppresses display of the second extension line (see DIMSE2 System Variable).
members.value: true if the second extension line is to be suppressed; otherwise false.

members.name: TextBackgroundColor
members.summary: Sets the color for the text background in dimensions. (see DIMTFILLCLR System Variable).

members.name: TextBackgroundFillMode
members.summary: Controls the background of dimension text (see DIMTFILL System Variable).

members.name: TextColor
members.summary: Assigns colors to dimension text (see DIMCLRT System Variable).
members.remarks: The color can be any valid color number.

members.name: TextDirection
members.summary: Specifies the reading direction of the dimension text (see DIMTXTDIRECTION System Variable).

members.name: TextHeight
members.summary: Specifies the height of dimension text, unless the current text style has a fixed height (see DIMTXT System Variable).

members.name: TextHorizontalAlignment
members.summary: Controls the horizontal positioning of dimension text (see DIMJUST System Variable).

members.name: TextInsideExtensions
members.summary: Draws text between extension lines (see DIMTIX System Variable).
members.value: false: For linear and angular dimensions, dimension text is placed inside the extension lines if there is sufficient room.true: Draws dimension text between the extension lines even if it would ordinarily be placed outside those lines. For radius and diameter dimensions, TextInsideExtensions on (true) always forces the dimension text outside the circle or arc.

members.name: TextInsideHorizontal
members.summary: Controls the position of dimension text inside the extension lines for all dimension types except Ordinate. (see DIMTIH System Variable).
members.value: true if the text is to be drawn horizontally; false if the text is to be aligned with the dimension line.

members.name: TextMovement
members.summary: Sets dimension text movement rules (see DIMTMOVE System Variable).

members.name: TextOutsideExtensions
members.summary: Controls whether a dimension line is drawn between the extension lines even when the text is placed outside. (see DIMTOFL System Variable).
members.remarks: For radius and diameter dimensions, a dimension line is drawn inside the circle or arc when the text, arrowheads, and leader are placed outside.
members.value: true: Draws dimension lines between the measured points even when arrowheads are placed outside the measured pointsfalse: Does not draw dimension lines between the measured points when arrowheads are placed outside the measured points

members.name: TextOutsideHorizontal
members.summary: Controls the position of dimension text outside the extension lines (see DIMTOH System Variable).
members.value: true if the text is to be drawn horizontally; false if the text is to be aligned with the dimension line.

members.name: TextVerticalAlignment
members.summary: Controls the vertical position of text in relation to the dimension line (see DIMTAD System Variable).

members.name: TextVerticalPosition
members.summary: Controls the vertical position of dimension text above or below the dimension line (see DIMTVP System Variable).
members.remarks: The TextVerticalPosition value is used when ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.TextVerticalAlignment is off. The magnitude of the vertical offset of text is the product of the text height and TextVerticalPosition. Setting TextVerticalPosition to 1.0 is equivalent to setting ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.TextVerticalAlignment to on. The dimension line splits to accommodate the text only if the absolute value of TextVerticalPosition is less than 0.7.

members.name: TickSize
members.summary: Specifies the size of oblique strokes drawn instead of arrowheads for linear, radius, and diameter dimensioning (see DIMTSZ System Variable).
members.value: 0Draws arrowheads.>0Draws oblique strokes instead of arrowheads. The size of the oblique strokes is determined by this value multiplied by the value of ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.ScaleFactor.

members.name: ToleranceAlignment
members.summary: Gets or sets the vertical justification for tolerance values relative to the nominal dimension text. (see DIMTOLJ System Variable).

members.name: ToleranceDecimalPlaces
members.summary: Gets or sets the number of decimal places to display in tolerance values for the primary units in a dimension (see DIMTDEC System Variable).

members.name: ToleranceScaleFactor
members.summary: Specifies a scale factor for the text height of fractions and tolerance values relative to the dimension text height, as set by ACadSharp.Tables.DimensionStyle.TextHeight (see DIMTFAC System Variable).
members.remarks: For example, if ToleranceScaleFactor is set to 1.0, the text height of fractions and tolerances is the same height as the dimension text. If ToleranceScaleFactor is set to 0.7500, the text height of fractions and tolerances is three-quarters the size of dimension text.

members.name: ToleranceZeroHandling
members.summary: Controls the suppression of zeros in tolerance values (see DIMTZIN System Variable).
members.remarks: Value 0-3 affect feet-and-inch dimensions only.

members.name: ZeroHandling
members.summary: Controls the suppression of zeros in the primary unit value (see DIMZIN System Variable).

types.summary: Provides helper methods and constants for common mathematical operations, including angle conversions, floating-point comparisons, and rounding.

members.returns: The angle, in radians, between this vector and dir. The value is in the range [0, π].

parameters.dir: The vector to which the angle is measured.

members.name: GetAngle
members.summary: Calculates the signed angle, in radians, between this vector and the specified direction vector, using the given normal to determine the sign.
members.remarks: The returned angle is measured in the plane defined by this vector and dir, with the sign determined by the right-hand rule using normal. If the vectors are parallel, the angle is 0 or π depending on their direction.
members.returns: The signed angle, in radians, between this vector and dir. The value is in the range [0, 2π].

parameters.dir: The direction vector to which the angle is measured.
parameters.normal: The normal vector that defines the orientation of the plane in which the angle is measured. The sign of the angle is determined based on the direction of this normal.
